body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Hanics presented its Bluetooth bone conduction headphone ''I-BONE'' during CES 2007. It can be also used for those with hearing difficulties.
It is expected to be available by the end of January in USA, Japan, and UK market. Suggested price would be more than $500 USD.
